title: The force-push guard's remedy names the lease form that passes: `--force-with-lease=<ref>:<sha>`
why: The force-push guard refused `git push --force-with-lease origin other-checkout-cp-own`; its remedy named `--force-with-lease --force-if-includes`, and Claude Code's auto-mode classifier then denied that form ("[Git Destructive]"), so the lane fell back to a new branch name (lane other-checkout-cp-own, 03:16 CST; coordinator, 03:15 CST Nov 8). Runner 9's `--force-with-lease=<branch>:<sha>` passed with no ask at 01:16 CST, the form decision stale-safe-force-push allows alone.
note: Fix: the remedy names `--force-with-lease=<ref>:<sha>` with the sha read from the remote-tracking ref, and decision stale-safe-force-push's remedy sentence says the same. Prove the named form passes the guard (red: today's remedy text; green: the new one, and the named command allowed). The classifier part is the owner's settings and is not asked here; step lease-push-c-and-d (#1429, auto mode lets a lease push to a lane's own branch) holds that and is not the home of this remedy text. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 03:20 CST Nov 8. Lane session_013NEJL43pWHtXmcY4uquu7S started it (coordinator, 03:16 CST Nov 8).
